purpose: Define the controlled production backfill package, required live proofs, execution guardrails, pause/resume behavior and stop conditions without running production backfill from this source-only stage.

required_live_inputs.acceptance: Independent external dump copy SHA matches source SHA and isolated restore from that external copy proves schema/count/last-event/API-or-query smoke.
Operator confirms exact database name, server address, port, current schema version 8 and production fingerprint before any migration.
Database volume free >= 2.2x current database bytes; archive volume free >= projected archive bytes * 1.3; backup volume keeps the independent copy intact.
WAL can absorb one planned chunk burst with 2x margin; if not, initial chunk size is reduced before start.
Runtime account can create, fsync/rename, read and delete a non-payload probe in the V2 archive root.
Runtime role is not SUPERUSER/CREATEDB/CREATEROLE; storage owner/migrator/worker privileges match the migration contract.
Scheduler, collection and continuous recovery are disabled for the window; port/runtime state is recorded separately.

execution_plan.name: preflight_evidence_load
execution_plan.action: Load and verify all required live inputs; refuse execution if any proof is missing, stale, mismatched or produced from production mutation.

execution_plan.name: apply_migrations_9_10
execution_plan.action: Apply only migrations 9 and 10 inside the approved maintenance window; migration 11, migration 12, read/write routing and reclaim stay disabled.
execution_plan.rollback: Use rollback 10 then rollback 9 before any read/write cutover if migration/backfill is abandoned.

execution_plan.name: start_backfill_worker
execution_plan.action: Run one named worker with initial chunk size <= 25000, checkpoint lease, archive hash verification and WAL/duration telemetry.
execution_plan.rollback: Stop worker; V1 remains source of truth; incomplete V2 chunks are handled only by guarded rollback tooling.

execution_plan.name: bounded_progress_loop
execution_plan.action: Continue chunks only while every chunk is verified, WAL/headroom stays inside limits, no source/target mismatch appears and operator pause remains available.

execution_plan.name: completion_identity_proof
execution_plan.action: After high watermark completion, prove exact event/entity/link/fact counts, chunk hash coverage, archive coverage and V1 row counts unchanged.

execution_plan.name: stop_before_cutover
execution_plan.action: Stop after backfill acceptance. Do not enable V2 read/write, do not apply migration 11/12 and do not reclaim V1 in this stage.

hard_stop_conditions: external restore proof is missing or not from independent copy
production database identity differs from approved fingerprint
production schema version is not 8 before migrations
runtime role has SUPERUSER, CREATEDB or CREATEROLE
free-space or WAL headroom falls below accepted threshold
any chunk has source/target hash mismatch
V1 counts change unexpectedly during backfill
archive manifest or block hash verification fails
request attempts read/write cutover or V1 reclaim
strictly_forbidden: run without explicit one-run operator approval
apply migration 11 read/write routing in this stage
apply migration 12 external FK cutover in this stage
enable V2-primary writes in this stage
drop, truncate, rewrite or VACUUM FULL legacy V1 relations in this stage
delete old dumps or V1 archives in this stage
treat completed backfill as storage reclaim

next_stage.purpose: Prove V1/V2 runtime/search/report/findings semantic parity after controlled backfill before any read cutover.
